reason: The cited evidence (E1) directly supports increased yield strength and improved corrosion resistance with 5–10% Mo in a CrCoNiFe HEA, but provides no data on room-temperature creep, passivation film mechanisms, or the absence of embrittlement at 10% Mo, leaving three key premises unsupported.
premises: Mo addition increases yield strength of CrCoNiFe-based HEAs by ~20–30%
Mo addition improves corrosion resistance in 3.5 wt% NaCl
Mo addition reduces room-temperature creep via solution strengthening and microstructural stabilization
Mo addition promotes formation of stable, protective Mo-based passivation films
Beneficial effects hold for Mo additions up to ~10 at% without embrittlement or undesirable phases
